title: The halting language is not in NP
statement: For every effective machine coding scheme $c$, let $H_c$ be the language of bit strings $s$ for which there exist bit strings $\alpha,x$ with $s=\langle x,\alpha\rangle$ such that the machine decoded from $\alpha$ halts on input $x$, with some output, after some finite number of steps. Then $H_c$ does not belong to $\mathrm{NP}$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is an effective machine coding scheme
replaced:
For every effective machine representation scheme $c$, the language of bit strings on
which its halting function returns true does not belong to NP.
